# CiteReady

> CiteReady is a fix-first AI search audit for small agencies. It checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI can reach, understand and quote a website, scores it 0–100, and gives copy-paste code for every fix. White-label reports start at $29/month.

## Main pages

- [Free AI search audit](https://citeready.app/): Paste a URL, get a score and fixes in about 10 seconds
- [Pricing](https://citeready.app/#pricing): Free, $9 one report, $29/month Agency, $79/month Pro
- [About](https://citeready.app/about): Who builds CiteReady and how the audit works

## Free tools

- [AI crawler checker](https://citeready.app/tools/ai-crawler-checker): Is my site blocked by ChatGPT, Perplexity or Claude?
- [AI-ready robots.txt generator](https://citeready.app/tools/robots-txt-generator): Allow AI search bots, choose about training bots
- [llms.txt generator and validator](https://citeready.app/tools/llms-txt-generator): Generate or check an llms.txt file
- [What AI bots see](https://citeready.app/tools/what-ai-bots-see): View a page as raw HTML without JavaScript
